title: CDO Expression into OnePot PURE
author: Laura Kvedarauskaite
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7nhhmb6

steps.title: Label PCR tubes
steps.instruction: Label three PCR tubes according to the intended reactions.

steps.title: Add catechol, CDO, water
steps.instruction: Add catechol, CDO enzyme, and water to each tube as specified in the materials chart.

steps.title: Centrifuge briefly
steps.instruction: Spin the tubes briefly in a centrifuge to collect all liquid at the bottom.

steps.title: Incubate reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes for 1 hour at 37 °C.

steps.title: Add energy mix and components
steps.instruction: To each tube, add the Energy solution, protein mixture, and ribosomes.
